title: Polynomial mixing of the switch chain for every graphical degree sequence
main_claim: For every graphical degree vector d on n>=4 vertices, the lazy switch chain (uniform 4-set, uniform ordered matching pair) has spectral gap >= [24 n^2 C(n,4)]^{-1} and t_mix(1/4) <= 2n^8. The key step is H^2 >= H for H = sum over pairs of (I - E_a), where E_a is the pair-Curveball heat bath. Corollary: an exact uniform sampler with expected polynomial bit cost.
coverage:
Read all sections line by line.
(1) Lemma 3.1, fixed blocks: transposition-generator spectral argument. The row-function spaces are J-invariant, and each transposition changes at most two blocks. OK.
(2) Lemma 3.2, random counts: the adjacent-total quantile coupling Y_{s-1} <= Y_s <= Y_{s-1}+1 holds (the likelihood ratio is monotone), and the eigenvector argument gives |lambda-1| <= 1. OK.
(3) Lemma 3.3: total-variance decomposition, with E[f_i|k] depending only on k_i. OK.
(4) Prop 4.1, triple encoding table: row sums and extra columns checked for e=0..3. The bijection onto fixed-margin matrices holds, the identification E_{jk} = E[.|S_i] holds, and the Cauchy-Schwarz step gives H_T >= I on centered functions. OK.
(5) Prop 5.1, disjoint pairs: (X,Y) is independent in every case except s=2 with the center present. The conditional law of Y given X depends only on 1{c=1}. Rank-one decomposition, plane algebra (norms 1-rho^2, inner product rho(1-rho^2)), and the inclusion of the error lines in ran R_{a,b} all verified.
(6) Lemma 6.1, slice comparison: verified the mu_1 formula and the bound mu_1 <= N/2 (sympy identity), the trace bound mu_2 <= (N-1)/(N-3), and the G actions N/2 and N-1. Numerically checked S <= G for all N <= 8 and all q.
(7) Expansion H^2 = sum_T H_T^2 - (n-3)H + D. OK.
(8) Havel-type connectivity: the switch vi,jk -> vj,ik exists because v is in B\A and |A| >= |B|. OK.
(9) Comparison h_a <= n^2 J_a via a path argument, and sum_a J_a = 2L via the two pair realizations of each switch. P_d off-diagonal entries are 1/(12 C(n,4)). Gap, TV bound and the 2n^8 arithmetic all OK.
(10) Exact sampler: domination (1-delta)p <= 1/M, nonnegativity of the integer weights, and the delta * 2^{2B} cost accounting. OK.
Brute-force numerics: built H exactly on Omega_d for every degree vector with n=4,5,6, and for sorted degree vectors with n=7 and |Omega_d| <= 1500 (278 classes). In every case the minimum nonzero eigenvalue of H is 2 (>= 1 is what is claimed) and the kernel is 1-dimensional.
sibling_notes: No sibling entries existed in family 131 at the time of review. The proof is self-contained. The three-row lemma reproves FQW26 Thm 5.1 rather than relying on it, so there is no circular dependence on companion papers.
